data.title: Celebrate the War Robots Anniversary with Special Events!
data.content:
Celebrate the anniversary of the War Robots franchise with a special live event on April 21, and festivities starting on April 9! Check out the live events hub for more details, and pencil the following dates in your diaries:

  • Leak Hunt (April 9): Look for clues and try to predict the announcements in the upcoming live stream.
  • War Robots Awards (April 9): Have your say and vote in the War Robots Awards including Robot Of The Year, Gun Of The Year, and more! 
  • Live Streams & Twitch Drops (April 21-24): Tune in to War Robots: Frontiers live streams on Twitch hosted by our amazing content creators and earn in-game content via Twitch Drops.
  • Special Live Event (April 21): War Robots and War Robots: Frontiers bring you a special live show stream, featuring a cinematic trailer, developer diary, and roundtable discussion with the devs.

Enjoy the celebration events!
